scope: Hexly-only local review; source project, profile, R2 and publication unchanged

description.en: Folded page contours and quiet ruled margins are pressed into a continuous folio surface.
description.zh: 折页轮廓与轻浅界线压印在连续的诗卷纸面上。

design.motif: Folded page contours and broken margin ruling
design.rationale: The reading room uses poetry and archived textual variants. Folded paper and margin traces suggest a folio, without inventing writing or modifying the product identity.

purpose.en: A digital reading room for Mao Zedong's poetry.
purpose.zh: 毛泽东诗词数字阅览室。
